page.content:
2014 investigation of Hae Min Lee's murder and Adnan Syed's conviction.

How Serial Season 1 connects

  • Topic: Serial — Season 1 is Serial's first and defining season.
  • Character: Adnan Syed — Adnan Syed is the convicted man Season 1 investigates.
  • Character: Hae Min Lee — Hae Min Lee is the murder victim at the center of Season 1.
  • Location: Baltimore — Season 1 investigates a 1999 murder and trial in Baltimore.
  • Artist: Sarah Koenig — Sarah Koenig reported and hosted Season 1.
  • Event: Serial Season 1 debut — The 2014 debut launched Season 1 as a mass weekly listen.
  • Concept: true-crime podcast form — Season 1 became the template for the true-crime podcast form.
  • Character: Jay Wilds — Jay Wilds is the state's key witness in the Season 1 case.
  • Work: Serial Season 2 — Season 1 came before the Bergdahl season.
  • Concept: Koenig narration — Koenig's narration is the voice of Season 1.
  • Character: Asia McClain — Asia McClain is the classmate whose library alibi Season 1 examines.
  • Character: Rabia Chaudry — Rabia Chaudry brought Adnan's case to Koenig and opened Season 1.
  • Concept: cell-tower evidence — Cell-tower records are a central piece of evidence Season 1 re-reads.
  • Work: Undisclosed — Undisclosed followed Season 1 as a second investigation of Adnan's case.
  • Event: Adnan Syed conviction vacated — The vacatur came years after Serial Season 1 made the case famous.
  • Work: Undisclosed — Season 1's audience and loose ends inspired Undisclosed.

What is Serial Season 1?

Season 1 is the Baltimore high-school case: Hae Min Lee disappeared in 1999, Adnan Syed was convicted, and Sarah Koenig spent twelve episodes on the alibi, the cell records, and whether the jury got it right.

Key threads lead to Serial, Adnan Syed, Hae Min Lee, Baltimore, Sarah Koenig and Serial Season 1 debut.
